motivation: The diagonal HEAD_ONLY comparison confounds frozen-body differences with initial readout differences. First six completed locus seeds had been inspected when this confound was identified. This is a fixed attribution control, not a rescue of the prior gate.
design: 2x2 factorial of body origin TJA/TEN and initial head origin TJA/TEN. Reuse diagonal HEAD_ONLY runs of original locus experiment; train only two off-diagonal conditions, 250 identical English updates each. No extra head choices or interpolation.
training: Same core, data hashes, hidden weight history0.5, HEAD_ONLY requires_grad mask, AdamW0.001, batch16, context128, exact historical English minibatch seeds.
evaluation: Same exact-line-clean document endpoints and checkpoints 0,1,5,10,25,50,100,150,200,250. All choices inherited from locus plan.
primary: At update250 compute TEN-body minus TJA-body English NLL separately under each common initial head, then average the two within each seed. Exploratory attribution gate requires negative body effect for >=9/10 seeds and mean <=-0.01 nats/byte, with audits passing. Report conditional effects for each head even if they disagree.
secondary: Head main effect and factorial interaction at step0 and step250; initial advantage versus differential loss reduction; Japanese scores with swapped head and saved body-native Japanese head.
uncertainty: Paired-seed bootstrap10000 draws RNG99019. Existing cohorts only; no independent replication claim.
stopping: Exactly20 off-diagonal branches and5000 optimizer updates. No additional layer swapping, heads, coefficients or budgets after outcomes. Original locus gate remains unchanged.
